title: A Temporal Network Approach to Paranoia: A Pilot Study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size (n = 23); - Data did not meet normality assumptions; - Low ESM compliance; - Network models are low dimensional; - No tools available to test robustness of temporal networks.
notes: The study is a pilot study with a small sample size. The authors note that the temporal model can only detect potential causal associations over a number of hours. Centrality was assessed visually, not statistically. The data and code are publicly available on OSF.
